responsibility: This file implements the Fortran front end’s diagnostic buffering and reporting layer on top of GCC diagnostics. It tracks suppression state, buffered-versus-immediate emission, warning-to-error conversion, pretty-printer buffers, and location-aware formatting for Fortran source lines and wide characters, and provides the gfc_error/gfc_warning/gfc_internal_error family plus save/restore of buffered diagnostic state used during speculative parsing and semantic checking.
